pack.author: ai
pack.notes: Original creative direction; no external assets.

data.description: A flat, geometric reveal that builds the brand's logo from its own shapes and colours, ending on a clean, centred lock-up that can be used as an outro or a sting.

brief.mood: Precise, modern and premium; calm confidence.
brief.pacing: Medium: a 3 to 4 second build, a 0.3 second settle with slight overshoot, then a 2 second hold. Motion follows one direction throughout.
structure: Two or three primitive shapes in brand colours move in and assemble (0.3-2.5 s)
The shapes resolve into the logo; the wordmark slides out from behind it (2.5-3.5 s)
Optional tagline fades in under the wordmark
Hold the final lock-up, perfectly centred, for 2 s
doNot: Never distort, recolour or crop the user's logo
No 3D, bevels, lens flares or glows
No more than three moving parts at once
Do not add sound effects unless the user supplies them
brief.qualityBar: The final frame matches the logo exactly, centred with safe margins; the animation reads well at 50% size; colours come only from the brand palette.
